strengths: Forgiveness and repair are tailored to later-life family relationships.
The line from mercy to softened charity is emotionally stable.
concerns: Catholic mode consistency is the weakest part; the prayer reads broadly Christian and could use confession, sacramental reconciliation, or Church-shaped contrition more explicitly.
grader_note: Approved because the prayer is otherwise strong, but it is close to the concern threshold due to muted Catholic distinctives.
